subtitle.title: Subtitles
subtitle.tooltip: Inspect video files, extract subtitle tracks to SRT/ASS/VTT, merge external subtitles into MKV, convert formats, and shift timings.
subtitle.noFileSelectedDesc: Open a video file to enumerate its tracks and extract subtitles.
subtitle.fixDriftHint: Use this when subtitles start in sync but slip further off the longer the video plays. A plain shift can't fix that; the frame rates differ.

audio.title: Audio
audio.tooltip: Extract audio tracks from video, merge external audio into containers, and remove unwanted audio tracks.
audio.noFileSelectedDesc: Open a video file to view and extract its audio tracks.

batch.title: Batch Operations
batch.tooltip: Scan directories for video files and run batch subtitle extraction across multiple files at once.
batch.noFilesScannedDesc: Select a directory to recursively scan for video files and preview their tracks.

mergeSubs.title: Merge External Subtitles
mergeSubs.noneAvailable: None of the selected files have a detected external subtitle ready to merge.
mergeSubs.deleteOriginals: Delete original external file after merge
mergeSubs.defaultAudioForAll: Default audio language (applies to all files)
mergeSubs.defaultSubtitleForAll: Default subtitle language (applies to all files)
mergeSubs.needsAttention: {count} file(s) don't have a matching track for the selected default — review them below.
mergeSubs.rowNeedsAttention: This file doesn't match the collective default — needs manual review.
mergeSubs.replaceOriginal: Replace the original video with the merged one
mergeSubs.replaceOriginalOff: Off: the result is saved as “… .merged.mkv” next to the original, so your media server may list the episode twice.
mergeSubs.replaceOriginalOn: On: the original file is overwritten once the merge succeeds. Video and audio are copied, not re-encoded.

extractLangPicker.title: Choose Languages to Extract
extractLangPicker.description: Pick which subtitle language(s) to extract across the selected files.
extractLangPicker.noTracks: No subtitle tracks found in the selected files.
extractLangPicker.besideHint: Recommended: Plex, Jellyfin and Kodi find them automatically.

autoTranslate.title: Auto-Translate
autoTranslate.autoMerge: Merge into video automatically when done
autoTranslate.setDefaultSubtitle: Make this the default subtitle track
autoTranslate.ambiguousTrack: {count} file(s) have more than one matching subtitle track and need manual review — pick the right one below:
autoTranslate.noProviders: No translation providers are configured. Open Settings > API & Providers to add one.
autoTranslate.noSubtitleTrack: No subtitle track found on this file.

transcribe.title: Speech to Text
transcribe.tooltip: Transcribe audio and video to subtitles using faster-whisper. Choose a model, set options, and run.
transcribe.modelNotCached: This model is not cached. It will be downloaded on first use (may take several minutes for large models).
transcribe.noMediaSelectedDesc: Open an audio or video file to transcribe it to subtitles.
transcribe.notInstalledBody: Transcription runs locally with faster-whisper, which wasn't found on this computer. Install it once and this page will unlock.
transcribe.notInstalledHint: Needs Python 3. If your system blocks global pip installs, use a virtual environment (python3 -m venv ~/.venvs/subforge) or pipx. A NVIDIA GPU makes it much faster but isn't required.

translate.title: Translate
translate.tooltip: Translate subtitles with AI or machine translation engines. Choose a local or cloud provider, set languages, and run.
translate.ollamaDesc: Ollama runs large language models locally on your machine.
translate.ollamaSetup: 1) Download Ollama from https://ollama.com/download. 2) Run "ollama pull llama3.1" in a terminal to download a model. 3) Make sure the Ollama service is running in the background before starting a translation.
translate.ollamaSecurity: Fully local — your subtitles never leave your machine. Open-source.
translate.libreDesc: LibreTranslate is a self-hosted machine translation API.
translate.libreSetup: Run via Docker: docker run -it -p 5000:5000 libretranslate/libretranslate
translate.libreSecurity: Self-hosted — you control the server. Open-source (AGPL).
translate.deeplDesc: DeepL is a cloud translation service with high-quality neural MT.
translate.deeplSetup: Get a free or Pro API key at https://www.deepl.com/pro-api
translate.deeplSecurity: Cloud service — subtitles are sent to DeepL servers over HTTPS. Data handled per DeepL's privacy policy.
translate.openaiDesc: OpenAI provides GPT models for high-quality translation via API.
translate.openaiSetup: Get an API key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
translate.openaiSecurity: Cloud service — subtitles are sent to OpenAI servers over HTTPS. Review OpenAI's data usage policy.
translate.googleDesc: Google Cloud Translation provides neural machine translation via API.
translate.googleSetup: Enable the Cloud Translation API and create credentials at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials
translate.googleSecurity: Cloud service — subtitles are sent to Google servers over HTTPS. Review Google's data usage policy.
translate.errorOllamaUnreachable: Couldn't reach Ollama. Make sure it's running on your machine (`ollama serve`) and that the address in Settings is correct.
translate.errorDeeplUnsupported: DeepL does not support {lang}. Choose another language or a different provider.
translate.noModels: No models found. Make sure Ollama is running.
translate.noSubtitleSelectedDesc: Open a subtitle file and choose a translation engine to get started.

settings.title: Settings
settings.tooltip: Configure defaults, tool paths, and appearance for SubForge.
settings.themeDesc: Toggle between dark and light mode
settings.toolPathsDesc: Leave blank to use auto-detected paths. Only change these if SubForge cannot find your tools.
settings.apiProvidersDesc: Configure and test connections for metadata and translation providers used across SubForge.
settings.subtitleSourcesDesc: Search for existing subtitles online before translating.
settings.searchOnlineToggle: Search for existing subtitles before translating
settings.openSubtitlesHelp: SubForge doesn't ship a shared OpenSubtitles key — register your own free account and API key to enable file-hash matching, the most accurate way to find a subtitle for your exact release.
settings.tvmazeNoKey: TVmaze's API is free and public — no API key required.
settings.tmdbDesc: The Movie Database (TMDB) provides series and episode metadata for auto-matching filenames.
settings.tmdbSetup: Create a free account and request an API key at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api
settings.tmdbSecurity: Cloud service — series/episode searches are sent to TMDB over HTTPS.
settings.tvmazeDesc: TVmaze provides series and episode metadata as a free, public API.
settings.tvmazeSetup: No setup needed — TVmaze's API (https://www.tvmaze.com/api) requires no registration or key.
settings.tvmazeSecurity: Cloud service — series/episode searches are sent to TVmaze over HTTPS. No key is ever transmitted since none is required.
settings.fixRtlPunctuation: Fix punctuation in Arabic, Persian and Hebrew subtitles
settings.fixRtlPunctuationHint: Adds invisible right-to-left marks to translated lines so players don't put question marks and full stops at the wrong end. Turn off if a player shows stray boxes.

filePicker.willOverwrite: A file with this name already exists and will be replaced.
filePicker.emptyFolderMode: No subfolders here. You can still use this folder.
